About this site

MyNameLimo is a Seed Bloomer marketing campaign and information site for Singapore limo and chauffeur drivers. It is not a limousine company, transport booking platform or ride coordinator.

Information only

The site describes a website service. Nothing here promises bookings, search rankings, income or any particular business result. Results depend on many factors, including the driver's service, reputation and use of the website.

Enquiries and services

An enquiry does not create a contract. Any website work, price, scope, timing and payment terms will be agreed separately in writing with Seed Bloomer.

Hosting and basic care

The S$488 website package includes the first year of website hosting and basic care. From the second year onwards, continued hosting and basic care is S$200 per year.

Basic care includes:

  • website hosting
  • SSL/security certificate
  • keeping the website operational
  • routine technical maintenance
  • reasonable minor updates to existing content, such as contact details, service wording, vehicle details or replacing an existing image

Basic care does not include major redesigns, substantial content changes, new pages, new functionality or significant development work. Those can be quoted separately.

Seed Bloomer will contact the customer regarding renewal before the next annual period. S$200 is not an automatic recurring charge.
